snippet.title: Zero Ops First Look UE5 Gameplay Test (Includes fan made map and skins)
snippet.description: DISCLAIMER: This video features fan-made content created solely as a proof of concept for Zero Ops. Any recognizable maps, character models, sounds, animations, or other assets shown are temporary demonstration materials and will not be included in the final game. Zero Ops will feature entirely original maps, characters, assets, and content. This project is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Sony Interactive Entertainment.
